name: Mall Event Booth
summary: A distinctive jade, brass and walnut event booth with replaceable poster and display-content source collections.
description: An original mall campaign booth kit with an framed backdrop, framed poster panel, guest counter and small product display vignette.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled BSDF materials. Blender bundled Bfont labels are retained as editable source text and exported as geometry. No external textures, models, or branded artwork.

replacement.note: Edit the generator and regenerate, or edit the Blender collections and export those named groups without rerunning the generator. The gallery does not edit content live.

accuracy_notes: Original decorative concept, not an official mall product, fabrication, accessibility, or engineering specification. Dimensions are measured from the actual standalone GLB.

attribution.credit: Original geometry authored for Blender-3D-Gallery. Labels use Blender bundled Bfont, retained as editable source text and exported as geometry.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
